deceptive_framing.quote: the deception approach measures the wrong thing... Deliberately maximizing deception of a putative moral patient undercuts the ethical stance

actually_commit_money.quote: make the stakes actually real instead of faking them. That is both more ethical and produces better data.

debrief.quote: At end of session, the model is told the full purpose... subjects are debriefed... deception-minimizing, consequence-honoring standard analogous to human-subjects norms.
